description: This file defines an abstract class 'LifecycleSubject' that manages lifecycle stages, including starting and stopping stages, observing lifecycle events, and logging performance metrics. It is part of the Orleans framework and handles lifecycle observation and coordination.

classes.name: LifecycleSubject
classes.description: An abstract class that provides lifecycle management, including start and stop procedures, observer subscription, and logging.

classes.name: LifecycleSubject.OrderedObserver
classes.description: A nested class representing an observer's participation in a specific lifecycle stage, implementing IDisposable.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Starts the lifecycle stages in order, invoking observers' OnStart methods, and logs performance.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Stops lifecycle stages in reverse order, invoking observers' OnStop methods, and logs performance.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to a specific lifecycle stage.

methods.name: GetStageNames
methods.description: Retrieves a dictionary of stage numbers and their names based on reflection of a given type.
